overview: Football academy player registry for SSB Sas Kanggooroo with player cards, search, registration, admin management, and PDF profiles.
features: Player registry with profile cards (photo, position, NISN, stats, medical, documents)
Live search and position filter (All, GK, DF, MF, FW)
Open public player registration form with document upload
Total player count and position distribution statistics
Admin dashboard with edit/delete (Internet Identity login)
